meaning.en: Whose five arrows are the subtle elements
meaning.hi: पंच तन्मात्राओं को बाण रूप में धारण करने वाली

explanation.en: Her fourth emblem is five arrows: the five tanmātras, the subtle essences of sound, touch, form, taste and smell. Tradition pictures them as five flowers.

inner.en: Sound, touch, form, taste and smell are the subtle roots of all experience. Every experience that reaches us is her arrow; received as her gift, sensing itself becomes worship.

story.en: Kāma, the god of desire, fights with a sugarcane bow and five flower-arrows. The Devī holds the same weapons: the power of desire, now in the hands of the Mother.
